widget_mechanic: After applying ≥2 filters, an active-chip bar shows what is currently applied. Agent must verify each required chip is present (and no extras) before treating the result set as the answer.

source_inspiration.instruction: Show me the most popular open-source software on SourceForge that runs on Linux and macOS, belongs to the category of “Agentic AI”, is licensed under MIT, and has a production/stable development status.
source_inspiration.first_failure_summary: [6.4] Fine-grained grounding error: The click landed on the non-interactive blue header area rather than on a specific actionable element (e.g., the filter chip/x or “Clear Filters”), and no UI change resulted.
